en: A thin, flat material used for writing, printing or wrapping; or a newspaper; or a school assignment or essay.
ex: Please write your name on a sheet of paper.
請把你的名字寫在一張紙上。

en: Your mother and father; or a person who has a child.
ex: My parents are going to visit us next week.
我的父母下週要來看我們。

en: A large area of grass and trees where people can walk and relax; or to leave a car somewhere.
ex: We went for a walk in the park.
我們去公園散步。

en: One of the pieces that make up a whole; or a role in a play; or to separate.
ex: Learning English is a big part of my life.
學英語是我生活中很重要的一部分。

en: A social event at which people enjoy themselves; or a political group; or a group of people doing something together.
ex: We had a party for her birthday last Saturday.
上星期六我們為她的生日辦了派對。

en: To go past something; or to give something to someone; or to succeed in a test.
ex: Can you pass me the salt, please?
可以請你把鹽遞給我嗎？

en: The time before now; or happened at an earlier time; or beyond something.
ex: In the past, people traveled by horse.
在過去，人們騎馬旅行。

en: To give money to someone for goods or services; or the money paid for work.
ex: I will pay for the lunch today.
今天的午餐我來付錢。

en: An instrument for writing or drawing with ink; or a small enclosed area for animals.
ex: Please sign your name with a blue pen.
請用藍色筆簽名。

en: A thin wooden tool with a black core used for writing or drawing.
ex: She drew a picture with a pencil.
她用鉛筆畫了一幅圖。

en: Men, women and children in general; or the members of a nation.
ex: Many people visit this beach in summer.
夏天有許多人來這座海灘。

en: Used to say that something is possible but not certain.
ex: Perhaps it will rain this afternoon.
今天下午也許會下雨。

en: A man, woman or child; a human being as an individual.
ex: She is a very kind person.
她是個非常善良的人。

en: An animal that you keep at home and look after, such as a dog or cat; or something you like best.
ex: Do you have a pet at home?
你家裡有養寵物嗎？

en: A picture made with a camera.
ex: She took a photo of the sunset.
她拍了一張日落的照片。

en: A large musical instrument with black and white keys that you press with your fingers.
ex: She plays the piano beautifully.
她鋼琴彈得很好。

en: To choose something from a group; or to take flowers or fruit from a plant; or the best choice.
ex: We picked some apples from the tree.
我們從樹上摘了一些蘋果。

en: A meal that you eat outdoors, often in a park or on a beach.
ex: We had a picnic by the lake last Sunday.
上星期天我們在湖邊野餐。

en: A painting, drawing or photograph; or a mental image.
ex: She hung a picture on the wall.
她在牆上掛了一幅畫。

en: A baked food with a pastry crust and a filling of fruit, meat or vegetables.
ex: She baked an apple pie for the party.
她為派對烤了一個蘋果派。

en: A part of something that has been cut or broken off; or a single thing from a set.
ex: Would you like another piece of cake?
你想再吃一塊蛋糕嗎？

en: A farm animal with pink skin and a short tail that is kept for its meat; or a greedy person.
ex: The pig ran around the farm.
那隻豬在農場裡跑來跑去。

en: A thin, pointed piece of metal used to hold things together; or to fasten something with a pin; or a secret number.
ex: She used a pin to hold the paper on the board.
她用大頭針把紙固定在板子上。

en: A pale red color; or having this color.
ex: The little girl wore a pink dress to the party.
小女孩穿著粉紅色洋裝去參加派對。

en: A tube through which water or gas flows; or a tube used for smoking tobacco; or to send something through a tube.
ex: A water pipe broke and flooded the kitchen.
一條水管破裂，淹了廚房。

en: A particular area or position; or a house or home; or to put something somewhere.
ex: This is a nice place to have lunch.
這是個吃午餐的好地方。

en: A set of actions that you decide to do in the future; or to decide how to do something in advance.
ex: What are your plans for the weekend?
你週末有什麼計畫？

en: A large round object in space that moves around a star such as the sun.
ex: Mars is the fourth planet from the sun.
火星是離太陽第四近的行星。

en: A living thing that grows in the ground; or a large factory; or to put seeds in the ground.
ex: We planted a tree in the garden.
我們在花園裡種了一棵樹。

en: A flat dish that you eat food from; or a flat, thin piece of metal or glass.
ex: She put the cake on a plate.
她把蛋糕放在盤子裡。

en: To take part in a game or sport; or to make music with an instrument; or a story performed in a theater.
ex: The children play in the park after school.
孩子們放學後在公園裡玩。

en: A person who takes part in a game or sport; or a person who plays a musical instrument.
ex: He is the best player on the basketball team.
他是籃球隊裡最好的球員。

en: A polite word used to ask for something; or to make someone feel happy.
ex: Please close the door when you leave.
你離開時請關門。

en: A feeling of happiness and enjoyment; or something that makes you feel this way.
ex: It is a pleasure to meet you.
很高興認識你。

en: Used after a time to show it is after twelve noon and before midnight.
ex: The shop closes at six p.m.
這家店下午六點關門。

en: A small bag sewn into clothes where you can carry things; or to take something dishonestly.
ex: He put his keys in his pocket.
他把鑰匙放進口袋。

en: A particular place or time; or the sharp end of something; or a single idea in an argument; or to show with a finger.
ex: The teacher pointed at the map on the wall.
老師指著牆上的地圖。

en: The people whose job is to protect the public and prevent crime.
ex: The police arrived quickly at the scene.
警察很快抵達了現場。

en: Behaving in a way that shows good manners and respect for others.
ex: He is a polite boy who always says thank you.
他是個有禮貌的男孩，總是說謝謝。

en: A small area of still water, usually smaller than a lake.
ex: Ducks were swimming in the pond.
鴨子們在池塘裡游泳。
